title: Rename a template's dependent name
summary: In a template, a call depending on a template parameter is renamed where the indexed instantiations resolve it to the renamed method; where one of them resolves it to another method, or no instantiation was indexed, it is left alone and named in a message

rename.notice:
Spellings of `area` left alone:
  ${WS}/main.cpp:13: double report(const T& shape) { return shape.area(); } (the name here also refers to `Square::area`, under another build configuration, as another candidate of a dependent call or in another instantiation)

Spellings of `area` left alone:
  ${WS}/main.cpp:21: double size_of(const Box<T>& box) { return box.area(); } (in a template, where no instantiation the index saw resolves the name to it)
